purpose: Teach: 聖なる/僧侶/悲観/電化/断食/途方/悪徳/投影

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、聖なる場所での器物損壊を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would handle the property damage at this sacred site, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing. Genuine curiosity wrapped in politeness. Pause before the question mark—Ren is working through something aloud, checking his understanding. Slightly hesitant intonation, not certainty-seeking but clarity-seeking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、僧侶を装った詐欺事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police also handle fraud cases where someone impersonates a monk.
lines.style: Clear and measured. Professional delivery without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet authority. Matter-of-fact, as if cataloging fact. Steady eye contact, no apologetic softening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、市民の悲観論を、警察、把握されますね
lines.en: So the police would be aware of the public's anxiety about all this, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Still thoughtful but with a slight edge of concern underneath. Gentle probe, not accusation. Ren's awkwardness shows in the pacing—slightly faster than comfortable, betraying he cares about the answer. Soft landing on the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、電化製品悪用の犯罪も扱います
lines.en: The police also investigate crimes involving the misuse of electronics and equipment.
lines.style: Steady informational tone. Officer Takeda is building a case through examples, not lecturing. Each sentence placed with precision. Slight forward lean in the delivery—this matters, listen closely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、断食を強要するカルト犯罪を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And the police would handle cases of cults that force people to fast, right?
lines.style: More urgent now. Ren's politeness cracks slightly—this one genuinely disturbs him. Faster pace than before. The 'right?' at the end has a quiet intensity, almost desperate for confirmation. Real emotion bleeding through the awkwardness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、途方に暮れる被害者に寄り添います
lines.en: The police stands beside victims who are lost and overwhelmed by what's happened to them.
lines.style: Warmer shift. Takeda's voice softens fractionally—he's moved from listing procedures to stating a conviction. Slower, more deliberate pacing. The weight of compassion in the delivery. Almost protective in tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、悪徳業者の摘発を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: So the police would work to expose and arrest these unscrupulous operators, correct?
lines.style: Ren's questions are becoming sharper. He's building to something. This one carries more assertion than before, less hesitation. Quick attack on the opening word. Still polite, but with purpose underneath. Seeking validation more than clarity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、3Dプロジェクター投影の偽証拠にも注意します
lines.en: The police are also alert to fake evidence created with 3D projection technology.
lines.style: Close, quiet warning. Takeda lowers his energy slightly—this is a caution, something specific. Deliberate pause before '3D projection.' The tone suggests expertise born from real cases. Final phrase marked with subtle precision, almost resigned awareness of what criminals can do now.
